steps.title: Set up Android Project
steps.description: Initialize a new Android project with the specified build environment.

steps.title: Define Application Name and Package
steps.description: Configure the application name and package identifier in the project metadata.

steps.title: Configure Backend Schema
steps.description: Define the backend API schema. Since this app does not require online data, the backend is disabled.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for MainActivity to display the current time prominently.

steps.title: Implement Time Display Logic
steps.description: Set up MainActivity.java to initialize UI components and prepare for time updates.

steps.title: Add Time Formatting
steps.description: Utilize SimpleDateFormat to format the current date and time in a user-friendly manner.

steps.title: Implement UI Update Mechanism
steps.description: Use an Android Handler and Runnable to schedule periodic updates of the time display every second.

steps.title: Manage Lifecycle for Time Updates
steps.description: Start the time update task in onResume() and stop it in onPause() to conserve resources.

steps.title: Finalize Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Ensure AndroidManifest.xml correctly declares the MainActivity and application theme.

steps.title: Building TimeDisplay
steps.description: The TimeDisplay Android application is now complete and ready for compilation.
